// CASE find_per_id expect=fire
export async function a1(ids: string[]) {
	const out = [];
	for (const id of ids) {
		const user = await db.users.find(id);
		out.push(user);
	}
	return out;
}
// CASE entries expect=fire
export async function a2(map: Record<string, string>) {
	for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(map)) {
		await cache.set(key, value);
	}
}
// CASE for_in expect=fire
export async function a3(obj: Record<string, Row>) {
	for (const id in obj) {
		await save(obj[id]);
	}
}
// CASE continue_guard expect=fire
export async function a4(items: Item[]) {
	for (const item of items) {
		if (!item.active) continue;
		await process(item);
	}
}
// CASE ui_clicks expect=fire
export async function a5(page: Page, selectors: string[]) {
	for (const selector of selectors) {
		await page.click(selector);
	}
}
// CASE join_per_item expect=fire
export async function a6(xs: number[]) {
	const results = [];
	for (const x of xs) {
		results.push(await Promise.all([left(x), right(x)]));
	}
	return results;
}
// CASE class_method_loop expect=fire
export class Syncer {
	async syncAll(users: User[]) {
		for (const user of users) {
			await this.sync(user);
		}
	}
}
// CASE labeled_continue expect=fire
export async function a8(groups: Item[][]) {
	outer: for (const group of groups) {
		for (const item of group) {
			if (item.skip) continue outer;
			await save(item);
		}
	}
}
// CASE switch_case expect=fire
export async function a9(events: Event[]) {
	for (const event of events) {
		switch (event.kind) {
			case "a":
				await handleA(event);
				break;
			default:
				log(event);
		}
	}
}
// CASE ternary expect=fire
export async function a10(xs: Item[]) {
	for (const x of xs) {
		x.ok ? await accept(x) : await reject(x);
	}
}
// CASE collect_then_all expect=pass
export async function b1(xs: Item[]) {
	const tasks = [];
	for (const x of xs) {
		tasks.push(save(x));
	}
	await Promise.all(tasks);
}
// CASE map_all expect=pass
export async function b2(xs: Item[]) {
	return Promise.all(
		xs.map(async (x) => {
			const y = await load(x);
			return transform(y);
		}),
	);
}
// CASE timer_callback expect=pass
export function b3(xs: Item[]) {
	for (const x of xs) {
		setTimeout(async () => {
			await save(x);
		}, 0);
	}
}
// CASE one_time_iterable expect=pass
export async function b4() {
	for (const x of await list()) {
		use(x);
	}
}
// CASE early_exit expect=pass
export async function b5(xs: Item[]) {
	for (const x of xs) {
		if (x.done) {
			await flush();
			break;
		}
		buffer(x);
	}
}
// CASE listener expect=pass
export function b6(xs: Item[]) {
	for (const x of xs) {
		emitter.on("e", async () => {
			await save(x);
		});
	}
}
// CASE header_init_await_only expect=pass
export async function b7() {
	for (let i = 0, total = await count(); i < total; i++) {
		use(i);
	}
}
// CASE lazy_local expect=pass
export async function b8(xs: Item[]) {
	let client: Client | undefined;
	for (const x of xs) {
		client ??= await connect();
		client.send(x);
	}
}
// CASE inorder_call_in_loop_body expect=fire
export async function b9(batches: Item[][]) {
	for (const batch of batches) {
		await inOrder(batch, save, {
			reason: "Each row update reads the previous balance",
		});
	}
}
// CASE inorder_step_callback expect=pass
export async function b10(rows: Item[]) {
	await inOrder(
		rows,
		async (row) => {
			const before = await read(row);
			await write(row, before);
		},
		{ reason: "Each row update reads the previous balance" },
	);
}
// CASE map_limit_call expect=pass
export async function b11(rows: Item[]) {
	await mapLimit(rows, 8, async (row) => {
		await save(row);
	});
}
